description.value: Be Fresh Market is a community-oriented organic cafe and local market in Kitsilano, cultivated by SPUD.ca, serving wholesome meals and fresh juices made from locally sourced and organic ingredients. It has earned a devoted neighbourhood following, with customers praising the house-made nut milks, specialty coffee, and relaxed work-friendly atmosphere. The 1900 West 1st Ave location is the flagship Cypress Market, with a sister store operating as Organic Acres on Main Street.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands at 6m; stands at 10m; stands at 15m; stands at 19m; stands at 28m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's locations page confirms the Cypress Market at 1900 West 1st Ave with phone 604 568 7783 and email cypress@befresh.ca, matching all OSM contact fields exactly. OSM tags internet_access=wlan with SSID 'BeFresh-GUEST', and a customer review referencing working on a laptop at the cafe provides corroborating evidence for Wi-Fi. No explicit evidence appears on the website for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill; OSM diet:vegan=yes is consistent with the website's pervasive emphasis on organic, health-focused food, supporting a vegan/vegetarian amenity claim.
concerns: OSM opening hours tags appear to differ from the hours listed on the website — the OSM record may be out of date on this field.
COVID-19 sanitation notice appears sitewide, suggesting some website content may not have been fully refreshed, though the copyright footer reads 2026.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active organic market and cafe with address, phone, and website all confirmed via website content. A practical stop for touring cyclists seeking healthy food and Wi-Fi in the Kitsilano neighbourhood.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website consistently emphasizes healthy, organic, locally sourced ingredients throughout, consistent with vegan and vegetarian options
